one_liner: Senior Executive Service director running DOE's National Training Center, which trains DOE/NNSA staff in nuclear security, safety, and protective-force skills (including live-fire ranges).
fit_summary: This SES job requires executive leadership plus technical qualifications in managing DOE safety and security training programs and specialized facilities such as live-fire ranges. Daniel aligned EMI course goals with FEMA field manuals and facilitated exercises, but his resume shows no executive or training program management, so skip it.
eligibility: Open to the public (U.S. citizens or nationals); no federal status is required.
Your 2-page resume must show both TQs: DOE safety/security Training Program Management and Advanced Training Infrastructure Management (live-fire range, integrated training complex, remote training).
Your 2-page resume must also show all five ECQs; separate narratives are not accepted, and OPM's QRB must certify you before appointment.
You must obtain and keep a Q Access Authorization (a DOE clearance), and a pre-employment drug test and OGE-278 financial disclosure may also apply.
strategy: Skip this one: his resume shows EMI course alignment and exercise facilitation, but no executive leadership or training program management, which this SES role requires.
GS-9/11/12 emergency management, exercise or training specialist roles at FEMA, DOE or Northern Virginia localities fit his resume.
resume_bullets: Aligned training goals between Emergency Management Institute courses and FEMA field guide training manuals.
Facilitated full-scale and tabletop exercises for federal, state and private-sector clients (2022–2024).
interview_questions: Describe a time you redesigned a training curriculum based on assessment findings or systemic trends.
How would you align NTC training resources with changing DOE and NNSA national security priorities while cutting waste?
Tell us about leading an organization through change and holding staff accountable.
How have you managed specialized facilities, contracts, or infrastructure?
watch_outs: SES-level role: without executive and DOE training-infrastructure experience, you are very unlikely to be rated Highly Qualified.
Requires a Q clearance, and a drug test and OGE-278 financial disclosure may also apply.
The location is listed only as multiple locations, though the NTC is based in Albuquerque, NM, so relocation from Manassas may be required.
